gloss: this transient world; the floating world

definitions.explanation: The everyday world and its troubles, seen as fleeting. From the Buddhist idea of the 'sorrowful world' ({憂|う}き{世|よ}), later written {浮世|うきよ}.
The world of fashion, theatre and the pleasure quarters in Edo-period cities, as in {浮世絵|うきよえ} and {浮世草子|うきよぞうし}.

examples.japanese: {浮世|うきよ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れる→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: To forget the cares of the world.

examples.japanese: {浮世|うきよ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{義理|ぎり}→義理：10891_giri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{断|ことわ}れなかった→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧。
examples.english: I couldn't refuse because of worldly obligations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浸|つ}かっている→浸かる：13290_tsukaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{浮世|うきよ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{悩|なや}み→悩み：06650_nayami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧くる。
examples.english: Soaking in a hot spring, the worries of this world start to seem unimportant.

examples.japanese: ⟦{浮世絵|うきよえ}→浮世絵：13286_ukiyoe⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{浮世|うきよ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{風俗|ふうぞく}→風俗：14694_fuuzoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}いた→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
examples.english: Ukiyo-e depicted the customs of the floating world.

examples.japanese: ⟦{江戸|えど}→江戸：19369_edo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{浮世|うきよ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{芝居|しばい}→芝居：03195_shibai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{流行|りゅうこう}→流行：03678_ryuukou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧だった。
examples.english: The floating world of Edo was a world of theatre and fashion.

examples.japanese: {井原西鶴|いはらさいかく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{町人|ちょうにん}→町人：13593_chounin⟧たち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{浮世|うきよ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{生|い}き{生|い}き→生き生き：10223_ikiiki⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られる→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: Ihara Saikaku is known as a writer who vividly portrayed the floating world of the townspeople.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
Originally {憂|う}き⟦{世|よ}→世：00424_yo⟧ (the sorrowful world). In the Edo period the spelling {浮世|うきよ} (floating world) took over, and the sense shifted toward the pleasures of the moment.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{浮世離|うきよばな}れ→浮世離れ：27677_ukiyobanare⟧: being out of touch with the real world
- {浮世|うきよ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{義理|ぎり}→義理：10891_giri⟧: worldly obligations
- ⟦{浮世絵|うきよえ}→浮世絵：13286_ukiyoe⟧: ukiyo-e woodblock prints

USAGE:
Sense 1 is literary or old-fashioned in speech; it survives mainly in set phrases.
